meta.title: Local Jetpack Docs
meta.author: Jetpack
meta.description: Mount local Jetpack documentation into the pinned upstream DocsPress runtime.

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $docs_root = realpath( '/wordpress/docspress-source-docs' ); $theme = wp_get_theme( 'docspress' ); $theme_root = get_theme_root( 'docspress' ) . '/docspress'; $importer = $theme_root . '/playground/import-local-docs.php'; if ( ! $docs_root || ! $theme->exists() || 'DocsPress' !== $theme->get( 'Name' ) || ! file_exists( $importer ) ) { wp_die( 'DocsPress local documentation importer is unavailable.' ); } update_option( 'active_plugins', array_values( array_unique( array_merge( (array) get_option( 'active_plugins', array() ), array( 'docspress-blocks/docspress-blocks.php' ) ) ) ) ); update_option( 'template', 'docspress' ); update_option( 'stylesheet', 'docspress' ); require $importer; foreach ( get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'posts_per_page' => -1, 'meta_key' => '_docspress_source_path' ) ) as $page ) { $source = (string) get_post_meta( $page->ID, '_docspress_source_path', true ); $relative = preg_replace( '#^docs/#', '', $source ); $filename = realpath( $docs_root . '/' . $relative ); if ( ! $filename || ! str_starts_with( $filename, trailingslashit( $docs_root ) ) || ! is_file( $filename ) ) { wp_die( 'An imported documentation source path is invalid.' ); } $markdown = file_get_contents( $filename ); if ( false === $markdown ) { wp_die( 'An imported documentation source could not be read.' ); } if ( ! metadata_exists( 'post', $page->ID, '_docspress_sidebar_collapsed' ) ) { wp_die( 'An imported documentation Page is missing its authored navigation state.' ); } delete_post_meta( $page->ID, '_docspress_sidebar_id' ); delete_post_meta( $page->ID, '_docspress_sidebar_root' ); $content = preg_replace( '/<!--\s*docspress:.*?\s*-->\s*/s', '', (string) get_post_field( 'post_content', $page->ID, 'raw' ), 1 ); $content = preg_replace( '/(<pre class=\\x22wp-block-code\\x22><code)\\s+class=\\x22language-[A-Za-z0-9_+.-]+\\x22>/', '$1>', $content ); $metadata = array( 'version' => 1, 'key' => trim( get_page_uri( $page ), '/' ), 'source' => $source, 'hash' => hash( 'sha256', $markdown ), 'sourceContentBase64' => base64_encode( $markdown ), 'sidebarPosition' => (int) $page->menu_order, 'sidebarCollapsed' => rest_sanitize_boolean( get_post_meta( $page->ID, '_docspress_sidebar_collapsed', true ) ) ); wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $page->ID, 'post_content' => wp_slash( '<!-- docspress:' . wp_json_encode( $metadata ) . " -->\n" . $content ) ) ); } require_once $theme_root . '/inc/llms.php'; docspress_flush_llms_rewrite_rules(); require '/wordpress/jetpack-docs-playground/configure-jetpack-site.php'; jetpack_docs_configure_site();
